purpose: Auxiliary 2Wiki sentence-level surface-realization diagnostic; not an independent estimate of construction-time provenance circularity

rule.primary: realized=1 iff exists triple (s,r,o): norm(title)==norm(s) AND norm(object) substring of norm(sentence); norm=lowercase+whitespace-collapse; no aliases
rule.paren_stripped_variant: same, but title additionally matched after stripping one trailing parenthetical disambiguator
rule.bias: conservative lower bound (object aliases/paraphrases not expanded)
